brief:
MYSTERY BOX. Every chef must build around this theme: "Mock theme about atlass". Interpret it however you like, but a judge should see the connection without being told.

SECRET INGREDIENT. On top of the theme, every dish must obey this: Canvas only. Everything the user sees must be drawn on a single <canvas> element: no HTML buttons, inputs, or text outside it. A dish that ignores it is marked down hard, by the judges and by machine.
